scientific_integrity: The expression is proved for every finite commutative chain ring, including equal and mixed characteristic, by residue-rank and local lifting recurrences. Finite exhaustive checks are corroboration only; no claim of independent certification or historical priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Determinant valuation rather than individual nonzero fibers or Smith invariants; does not cover general non-chain local rings. Closely related 2026 topological zeta and local-rank reductions, and potential unindexed arithmetic equivalents, limit priority certainty.
title: A universal determinant-valuation zeta law for cubic Hankel matrices over finite chain rings
